description: Stalled display frame (a background tab returning) mid-run: two 2500 ms frames. RunScene clamps each frame delta to 50 ms before SimClock sees it, so the stalls buy no simulation time.
notes: VERIFIED 2026-11-21. Two 2500 ms display frames mid-run; stats.stallCount=2, droppedMs=0, and the run still ends at endTick=600 (exactly 5000 ms of SIM time for a 5000 ms tape). So a stalled frame contributes no simulation time: the run cannot fast-forward. NOTE the mechanism: RunScene.update() clamps the frame delta to 50 ms (src/scenes/RunScene.js:1167) BEFORE SimClock.advance() sees it, so 50 ms / 8.333 ms never exceeds SIM_MAX_TICKS_PER_FRAME and SimClock's own backlog drop (droppedMs) is NOT exercised here. This canary covers the clamp, not the cap; a future canary that stubs delta past the clamp would be needed to cover the cap itself.
